items.title: Guardant Health, Thursday's Stock Of The Day, Spikes After Hiking 2026 Outlook
items.summary: Guardant Health is Thursday's IBD Stock Of The Day in a thriving market for colon cancer screening tests.  On Friday, Guardant Health stock surged after the company raised full-year outlook after a Q2 revenue beat late Thursday.  Several analysts raised price targets on GH stock after the Q2 report, by as much as $50 a share, according to TheFly.com.

items.title: AbbVie’s (NYSE:ABBV) Q2 CY2026: Beats On Revenue
items.summary: Pharmaceutical company AbbVie (NYSE:ABBV) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 10.2% year on year to $16.99 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.65 per share was 1.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: GE HealthCare beats quarterly profit estimates on strong imaging demand, tariff refunds
items.summary: July 29 () - GE HealthCare on Wednesday beat Wall Street estimates for second-quarter profit, helped by strong demand for its ‌diagnostic and imaging devices and refunds of tariffs imposed under U. Shares of the medical device maker rose 12% in premarket trading.
